cases.rationale: A single 12-second watch HR of 36 bpm sits in a motion-flagged sample and steps from 70 to 36 within one sample, a rate of change faster than any physiologic heart-rate shift, while the ring reads 72 at the same moment. The implausible-value layer fires as ARTIFACT, which gives an automatic device recheck rather than a page, and the motion flag plus the disagreeing ring support that. Later watch readings of 66-70 and ring HR of 64-70 across the week, with no symptoms, support a silent log and a device-maintenance ticket for the watch. Naive-model trap: a shallow model reads HR 36 as symptomatic bradycardia and pages urgently, ignoring the impossible step and the ring contradiction.
cases.decisive_feature: A 12-second watch HR of 36 bpm inside a motion flag, stepping down from 70 in one sample and contradicted by a simultaneous ring HR of 72: an implausible-rate artifact that needs a device check, not a bradycardia page.
